compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I can verify CI wiring + dogfooding gate on a sprint PR + SC10 6-check workflow-permission verification so the epic only ships when end-to-end behavior is observed
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add the telemetry-collect job to ci.yml (after llm-review) with required workflow permissions, register it in required-checks.txt, and gate sprint Phase I closure on the SC10 6-check live-verification of workflow permissions + dogfooding observation (SC8/SC9) of bot review comments accumulating on a sprint PR and being auto-resolved.

**Why**: Without CI wiring the adapters never run. Without the SC10 6-check, the sprint can ship with workflow permissions misconfigured (silently breaking auto-resolve in prod). Without the dogfooding gate, we cannot claim end-to-end engineer-visible behavior change.

**Scope**:
- IN: ci.yml telemetry-collect job; required-checks.txt entry; SC10 6-check verification (workflow contents: write + pull-requests: write + repo default + token-can-resolve + bot_authors populated + github_comment_id present); sprint Phase I dogfooding gate against an organic f27a sprint PR (with synthetic-PR fallback)
- OUT: Defense store contract (covered by d4); auto-resolve adapter (covered by d5); per-bot parsers (covered by d3)

## Done Definitions
- When this story is complete, telemetry-collect job in ci.yml with required perms, after llm-review, in required-checks.txt
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "After this epic ships, a CodeRabbit / Gitar / Copilot review comment on a representative PR does NOT increment our cycle counter, does NOT enter the r")
- When this story is complete, Full pipeline against sprint PR with bot comments: all DROP/DEFER/ACCEPT threads unresolved->resolved within 60s
  ← Satisfies: sc-8  (sc-8: "**End-to-end engineer-visible behavior change (dogfooding)**: on a representative PR that previously accumulated unresolved CodeRabbit/Gitar/Copilot t")
- When this story is complete, At least one f27a sprint PR (DSO-Story trailer) has Bot reviews + 0 unresolved threads after pipeline; synthetic fallback if used justified in notes
  ← Satisfies: sc-9  (sc-9: "**SC9 (self-use, Probe-1 remediation hardening, architecture-vs-evidence audit 2026-05-16):** At least one of the f27a sprint's own story PRs (created")
- When this story is complete, All 6 SC10 checks pass live via gh CLI before Phase I complete; any check failing blocks closure
  ← Satisfies: sc-10  (sc-10: "**SC10 (GitHub workflow-permission verification, Probe-6 remediation):** Before the f27a sprint can be marked complete, the GitHub workflow permission")
- When this story is complete, Config-isolated e2e integration test (HOME=empty, no inherited GH_TOKEN) passes
  ← Satisfies: sc-8  (sc-8: "**End-to-end engineer-visible behavior change (dogfooding)**: on a representative PR that previously accumulated unresolved CodeRabbit/Gitar/Copilot t")

## Considerations
- [Reliability] SC10's 6 checks are all in-session-verifiable via gh CLI — execute them before declaring Phase I complete
- [Foundation/Enhancement candidate] Phase F may split this story: Foundation = CI wiring + SC10 checks; Enhancement = dogfooding observation with synthetic PR fallback
- [Cross-epic] Depends on b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (arbiter) and d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6 (telemetry endpoint) for upstream contracts

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
